name: arcane lock
lore:
### Entry IV: The Unyielding Seal (Arcane Lock)

To the uninitiated, an **Arcane Lock** is merely a door that refuses to budge. To the practitioner, it is an elegant braiding of the Weave into a static, unyielding knot. When shaping the spell, one feels a sudden tension in the air, akin to pulling a silken cord taut until it vibrates with a low, resonant hum.

Visually, the magic manifests as a brief, incandescent flare of sapphire or gold light tracing the seams of the portal. Ghostly sigils, ancient and immutable, flicker across the surface before sinking deep into the wood or iron. Once set, the object feels unnaturally rigid, as if it has become a singular, seamless piece of the world’s foundation.

Legend attributes this ward to the paranoid Archmage Valerius of Oakhaven. Besieged by marauders and lacking a physical key to his sanctum, Valerius is said to have "stitched" the door to reality itself using the weight of his own will. He survived the night, though his door remained shut for a century thereafter, defying every axe and ram brought against it.

*Heed this, traveler: where the Weave holds fast, brawn is but a fool’s errand.*
